sources.title: Civimatica Models | AI built on measured streets
sources.snippet: ← Civimatica 01 Offering 01: model access Civimatica Models Ready-to-use urban AI, trained on streets we measure. You plug in; we build, train and operate the stack. Talk to us about a model A model is only as real as its data Most urban AI is trained on proxies: payment records, scheduled transit, simulated streets.

sources.title: Civimatica | Physical AI for the real city
sources.snippet: Civimatica builds AI models for urban space and the sensing devices they run on, and gives companies the data, ground truth and real-street test environment to train and validate their own.
